description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query available region IDs.

description.zh: 标签键。该值不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包`含http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag key. This parameter cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 标签值。该值可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag value. This parameter can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
